24V-Class LiFePO4 Battery Kit for Mobile Robotics WHEELTEC P760S is a compact rechargeable lithium iron phosphate battery kit for 24V-class robot chassis, mobile automation projects and other compatible DC systems. This listing is specifically the P760S 24V 6000mAh LiFePO4 battery plus 25.55V 2.8A charger configuration. It is not a magnetic-mount, coulomb-meter or higher-capacity bundle. What Is Included WHEELTEC P760S LiFePO4 battery pack, 24V-class / 6000mAh 25.55V 2.8A LiFePO4 charger Do not assume that a magnetic mounting base, coulomb meter, extension harness or other accessories shown with other supplier configurations are included with this battery-and-charger kit. Electrical and Mechanical Specifications Battery model P760S Product voltage class 24V Battery-pack nominal voltage 22.4V Rated capacity 6000mAh Maximum charge voltage 25.55V Cut-off voltage 16.5V Maximum continuous discharge current 15A Battery dimensions 177 x 146 x 42mm Battery weight Approx. 1.72kg Enclosure Metal enclosure Charging connector DC 4.0 x 1.7mm Discharge connector XT60U Voltage note: “24V” is the product voltage class. The supplier specification identifies the pack's nominal voltage as 22.4V and its fully charged voltage as 25.55V. Verify your controller, motor driver and DC-DC converter input range against the full battery voltage range, not the product name alone. Supplied 2.8A Charger Charger output 25.55V DC, 2.8A Charger AC input 110-240V AC, 50/60Hz DC connector DC 4.0 x 1.7mm male Charger dimensions 142 x 61 x 37mm Charger weight Approx. 0.5kg Status indicator Red while charging; green when charged Use the supplied LiFePO4 charger and its matching connector. Do not substitute a charger intended for another battery chemistry or a different charge-voltage range. Protection and Operating Limits The supplier material lists protection against short circuit, overcharge, over-discharge, over-current and out-of-range charge/discharge temperature. It also lists the following operating limits: Charging temperature 0 to 45°C Discharging temperature -20 to 60°C Storage temperature -20 to 45°C These limits are not an instruction to continuously charge or discharge at the extremes. The supplier notes that long-duration, high-current discharge in extreme-temperature conditions can affect cycle life. Choosing and Integrating the Battery For 24V robot platforms: confirm the system accepts the pack's 16.5-25.55V operating range and that expected continuous current remains within 15A. For motor loads: account for startup and stall current, not just the normal running current. A protection trip or voltage drop can occur if the application exceeds the battery's capability. For mounting: plan for the 177 x 146 x 42mm enclosure and approximately 1.72kg battery mass. This listed configuration does not include a magnetic base. For cabling: use a compatible XT60U connection for the load side; check polarity before connecting to a controller or power distribution system. Safe Use and Charging Inspect the housing, cable and connectors before each use. Do not use a damaged, swollen, leaking or overheated battery. Charge on a non-flammable surface in a ventilated area, within the stated charging-temperature range, and do not leave charging unattended. Disconnect the load before wiring changes or storage. Avoid shorting the XT60U output. For transport and shipment, follow the carrier and destination rules applicable to lithium battery products; do not assume any air-travel eligibility. FAQ Does this kit include a coulomb meter or magnetic base?No. This listing is the 24V 6000mAh P760S battery plus 2.8A charger configuration only. Can I use a different charger?Use only a charger designed for this LiFePO4 pack's 25.55V charging requirement and compatible DC connector. The supplied 2.8A charger is matched to this kit. Is it suitable for every “24V” device?No. Check the actual device voltage range, connector, polarity and startup/current demand. The battery's specified range is 16.5-25.55V, with up to 15A continuous discharge.

The M5Stack Atomic Battery Base is a compact rechargeable power supply module specifically designed for the M5Stack Atom series. It provides reliable power for your M5Stack projects, featuring a 200mAh lithium battery with a stable 5V boosted output, making it perfect for IoT and portable applications. Utilizing the ETA9085E10 boost converter and the LGS4056HDA linear charging chip, the M5Stack Battery Base provides safe and efficient charging. It includes a battery voltage detection circuit and LED level indicators for real-time monitoring. The onboard DIP switch allows for easy toggling between charging and boost modes, which is ideal for rapid prototyping and mobile development with M5Stack devices. Key Features Designed specifically for the M5Stack Atom series ETA9085E10 high-efficiency boost converter LGS4056HDA linear charging management chip Built-in 200mAh lithium rechargeable battery LED indicators for battery level and charging status DIP switch for convenient switching between boost and charging modes Technical Specifications Specification Parameter Charging/Discharging Chip LGS4056HDA Boost Converter Chip ETA9085E10 Battery Indicator 4-level red LED Charging Indicator Blue (charging), Green (full) Battery Capacity 3.7V @ 200mAh Voltage Detection Circuit Included (divider-based) Charging Current 5V @ 223mA Boost Output Current Max 5V @ 300mA Standby Current 4.2V @ 2.55µA Operating Current 4.2V @ 39.55mA Temperature Range 0°C ~ 40°C Product Size 24.0 x 24.0 x 23.95 mm Product Weight 9.4g Package Size 47.0 x 46.0 x 27.0 mm Gross Weight 15.8g Applications Power source for M5Stack IoT devices Portable devices powered by M5Stack Mobile development and testing environments Embedded systems integrating the M5Stack Atom Includes 1 × M5Stack Atomic Battery Base Compatibility Note This M5Stack Battery Base is compatible with most Atom series products. If used with M5Stack Atom Echo Base, cut all right-side pins. If used with M5Stack Atom-Echo, cut the G33 pin.In both cases, it acts as a power supply only and cannot read battery voltage. Description The M5Stack Battery Module 13.2 is a 1500mAh battery module for the M5Stack stackable module series. It provides high-capacity lithium battery expansion for projects that need longer runtime in a compact stacked form factor. This stackable battery expansion module integrates a Seiko protection board with a higher cutoff protection voltage to help prevent overcharge and over-discharge. Multiple battery modules can be stacked to extend device battery life. Official test information: The battery has passed multiple safety tests. Official laboratory data lists 791mA charging current with about 110 minutes to full charge using Basic plus Module13.2 Battery, and 330mA discharge current with about 265 minutes of discharge duration using Basic plus Module13.2 Battery plus M5GO BOTTOM under the stated test setup. Features 1500mAh battery module for M5Stack stackable systems. Integrated Seiko protection board helps prevent overcharge and over-discharge. Supports stacking multiple modules to extend battery life. Battery passed multiple official safety tests. Compact stackable battery expansion for portable M5Stack projects. Over the years, DFRobot has broadened its scope to include STEM education, manufacturing, and industrial applications alongside its open-source hardware initiatives. The company offers an extensive array of products, such as sensors, robotic platforms, communication modules, and educational kits tailored for students and educators. Additionally, DFRobot provides comprehensive online documentation, sample codes, and schematics to assist users in getting started efficiently.

DFRobot, founded in 2008 and based in Shanghai, is a leading provider of open-source hardware, robotics platforms, and STEM education solutions. With a strong open-source spirit, high-quality products, and an active global community, DFRobot is committed to making innovation simple, accessible, and fun, while advancing technology education worldwide.

This Type-C LiPo Charger is a compact, high-efficiency charging module designed for single-cell 3.7V lithium batteries. Powered by the TP4056X charging IC, this USB-C battery charger delivers safe, fast, and adjustable charging, making it ideal for embedded and DIY electronics projects. Every lithium ion charging board supports three selectable charging currents (50mA, 200mA, 500mA) to accommodate different battery capacities. Using a Type-C LiPo Charger ensures modern connectivity for your Li-ion battery charging needs.
